about: How a film ends (tools/ci/ending.mjs). The owner, 2026-09-29: people forget to follow the page, so some films end on a follow reminder instead of the closing quote. The owner, 2026-10-02: every SECOND film from v63, and the line now first asks to comment the keyword „ვინარი“ for the link (the page sends the app's link in a DM), then to follow. Film number n (the v<n>- of its id) is a follow film when n >= from and (n - from) % every == 0 (v63, v65, v67 ...); a redo keeps its original's ending, and a film already made keeps the one it was made with. Its EndCard tagline and last spoken line are exactly one line of "follow", never one of the last "recent" distinct lines earlier films ended on, with no VINARI+ or price note under it. A line asks to follow the page, never to subscribe to the app: "გამოწერა" alone is also VINARI+, so a line says "გამოგვიწერე" (us) or names the page. Keep a line to about 52 letters (4.5 s of voice), each card row (between the "|") to 34 characters, informal შენ, no em dash, never "download" or a store name (build-index CTA). A line taken out of the bank moves to "retired", so the films that used it still count as follow films. "postLine" is the first paragraph of every film's post text, put there by tools/ci/publish.mjs (never by the spec), the owner 2026-10-02.
follow: დაწერე „ვინარი“ კომენტარში, | ლინკს მოგწერთ. და გამოგვიწერე.
„ვინარი“ დაწერე კომენტარში, | ლინკს მოგწერთ. გვერდიც გამოიწერე.
postLine: დაწერე კომენტარში „ვინარი“ და აპის ლინკს პირადში გამოგიგზავნით.

freeWeek.about: The free-week line (the owner, 2026-10-19: "films may say now and then that you can download it and try it free for a week"; true for first-time subscribers of VINARI+; the owner, 2026-10-21: EVERY SECOND film says it, from v120). THE ONE SWITCH: "on": false takes it out of every new film and Story set, and the call-to-action rule (tools/ci/words.mjs CTA, PUSHY) is strict again everywhere; films already made keep what they said. Film number n says it when on, n >= from, (n - from) % every == 0 and n is not a follow film (tools/ci/ending.mjs freeWeekFilm). The follow films are every second film too (from 63: the odd numbers), so "from" is a quote film's number and "every" 2: every film that is not a follow film says it, v120, v122, v124 ... (from 113 every 4 picked v113, v117, v121, all follow films, so not one film said it; ending.mjs --test now refuses a rule that loses a film to the follow ending). "skip": categories that never say it (the owner, 2026-10-21: the crazy stories, "stories", never mention the app, they are content of their own; the same day, car knowledge, "carinfo", too): an even-numbered film of them has no free-week line, and one that says it fails FREE_WEEK. A free-week film MUST say one line of "lines", word for word, as the whole beat right before the EndCard (its say, and its show if any; check: FREE_WEEK), never in the cover, the post, the EndCard line or a scene's text; a redo keeps what its original said. A line with „ულიმიტოდ“ only in a film whose category's facts make it true (ci/categories.json "unlimited"; never a QR card film: its messages a day are limited). A Story set may end on one as its end slide's body. The wording is an OPTION, never an order (the owner, 2026-10-21: „ნუ წერ ერთი კვირა უფასოდ სცადეო ... შეგიძლია 1 კვირა უფასოდაც სცადო“: the order pushes people to start the yearly trial instead of choosing the monthly plan): „შეგიძლია ... უფასოდაც სცადო“, never the imperative „სცადე“. Keep a line short (about 3 s), informal შენ, no em dash, no "!", never "now" or "today" (no urgency). tools/ci/ending.mjs --test checks the rule.
freeWeek.everyP2About: Phase 2 (src/lib/p2.mjs P2_FROM; the owner, 2026-10-26: studio films end with the free week + App Store and Google Play): from P2_FROM EVERY app film says one line of "lines", as the EndCard beat's own voice, said over the white store card (src/scenes/kit/endstores.tsx), and no film ends on the comment ask (it stays the post's first paragraph, postLine). tools/ci/ending.mjs storesProblems: STORES, END_HOLD.

stores.about: The white store card on every phase-2 film. silentFor: the categories whose card carries no free-week line (the owner, 2026-10-21: stories and car knowledge never mention the app): the card shows VINARI and the badges under the film's own closing line. One switch per category; the owner may ask for the free-week line there too.
